snippet.title: Stilt - Official Forgotten Trials Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Stilt gets a new update! Check out the latest Stilt trailer for this VR platformer game to see what you can expect with the Stilt: Forgotten Trials free update, featuring a new platform type, three new levels, and more improvements. Stilt's Forgotten Trials update is available now on Meta, PS VR2, and Steam. 


In Stilts, arm yourself with stilts and use your quick reflexes and problem-solving skills to succeed in single-player adventure or PvP multiplayer.
